2119988441622397337.en_summary: EliteOptions2 analyzes 76 years of post-midterm CPI data suggesting tomorrow is a small green day, though 2022 says otherwise. Since closing under 7400 on Friday, the S&P 500 has rallied over 170 points to 7550 after Thursday’s 4.4% flush. October CPI hits at 8:30 AM ET tomorrow, the first print since the midterms. Reviews all 19 post-midterm CPI prints since 1950 for $SPX close that day, outlining three potential scenarios.
2119988441622397337.zh_summary: EliteOptions2 分析76年中期選舉後CPI數據，顯示明日可能為小幅上漲日，儘管2022年情況相反。自週五收於7400以下後，標普500指數已反彈超過170點至7550，此前週四出現4.4%的大跌。明日上午8:30 ET將公布10月CPI，為中期選舉後首份數據。回顧1950年以來全部19次中期選舉後CPI公布當日$SPX的收盤情況，並提出三種潛在情景。
